title: Keep original source records as provenance stubs
decision: Original office/catalog source records from project/catalog.json should remain only as minimal non-browseable provenance stubs. They may preserve stable source IDs and human-readable labels for traceability, but they must not retain original file paths, open targets, download targets, or retained-file semantics.
context: Documents in the imported EPP corpus reference source_ids. After deciding that workspaces/epp-full/source-files should be physically removed, the remaining risk was dangling source_ids or app-visible metadata that still looked like browseable source files.
rationale: Provenance stubs preserve useful traceability without turning development-only original documents into app content. This keeps document metadata honest and prevents future source-detail or download affordances from exposing files that should not be retained.
alternatives_considered: Remove original source records entirely and allow source_ids to dangle
Keep original source paths in catalog metadata but do not copy the files
Retain original source files as hidden attachments
consequences: SG-0007 should normalize original catalog sources during import refresh
Document source_ids for development-only originals resolve to provenance-only records
The app should not offer open, browse, download, or attachment affordances for original source stubs
Retained regulatory sources remain separate app inputs and may keep the metadata needed for CFR and Survey Guidance views
